name: smwmusic-super-mario-bros-game-over
title: Super Mario Bros. - Game Over
description:
Ah yes, the classic song that plays whenever you lose all of your lives in what is undoubtedly one of the most influential video games of all time (and also a game that's somewhat ahead of its time, as back in 1985, they somehow managed to compress 32 levels onto a single 40-kilobyte cartridge, which even today, is SUPER impressive).

Good for you know... game over screens, especially on a retro-styled hack.
